activity.notes: Birger Jarl was the ruling riksjarl of Sweden from 1248 until his death in 1266. After King Erik Eriksson died in 1250, Birger's son Valdemar became king while Birger remained the dominant governing figure. He is therefore modeled as governing Sweden as Jarl rather than incorrectly as a king.

sources.citation_text: The Swedish History Museum lists Birger jarl as 'regerande riksjarl' for 1248-1266.

sources.title: Birger jarl
sources.citation_text: Nationalencyklopedin describes Birger as the king's closest man and notes that he retained power after his son Valdemar became king in 1250.
